messages: #b#p203##k in #b#m10001000##k seems to have something to tell you.

Took #p205#’s advice and visited #p203# to ask about #bAlloy#k, the author of #b#t4160001##k. She said her grandfather’s latest letter was about #bWing, the Fairy of #m10002000##k, and suggested I go see #p309#.
#p309# recalls #bAlloy#k as the human who obtained #r#o700004#’s#k shell to extend his own lifespan. Let’s ask a few more questions.
